_about: QA D1360 / D1378 / D1391 / D1395 / D1419 / D1426 / D1434: the shared frequency fixture. 'asNeeded' and 'notAsNeeded' pin the FROZEN round-31 phrase list (MarDoseSchedule.AS_NEEDED_PHRASES) that V260 backfilled prescriptions.as_needed from (PrnAsNeededBackfillMigrationIT runs the migration's SQL on every case and holds it equal to the Java reader). Since round 32 an order is as-needed only when the prescriber TICKS it. On an order NOT ticked there are exactly three outcomes, from one reader (FrequencyWording and MarDoseSchedule on the server, unTickedFrequencyVerdict and frequencyReading in the portal; FrequencyWordingTest and as-needed-frequency.spec.ts hold both to this file): 'fixedSchedule' reads as a schedule: accepted, and 'readings' says exactly how the MAR schedules it (REPEATING:minutes between doses, ONE_OFF, CONTINUOUS, COURSE:[minutes after the first dose]); FrequencyWordingTest drives MarNextDose over it, so an accepted wording can never show frequencyUnread. 'conditional' holds a real condition word or symptom: refused on asNeeded (every wording of D1360, D1378 and D1395 but the limit style, which the coordinator made a question). 'unreadable' is anything else: asked once on frequencyConfirmed, created when confirmed, frequencyUnread on the MAR. 'filed' lists the wordings of D1419 and D1426 word for word, each of which stands in one of the three lists. 'dropdown' is the portal's frequency dropdown: never asked. QA D1452-D1460 (round 35): a text is a schedule only when ALL of it is one form of the closed grammar (FrequencyCadence.GRAMMAR): 'grammarForms' states the reading of every form, and both sides hold that each of them beside each of 'matrixClauses', in front or behind, is not read. QA D1486, D1487, D1512 (round 36): every number and joining word of the grammar has its bound. 'slotBounds' says, per kind of form, which numbers read ('in') and which are asked ('out'): both sides generate every line of the grammar holding a number with each of them (words from 'slotSample'), so a line or a kind of form with no bound fails. The slots outside the table (clock times, courses, posology, doses, rates, number words) are in 'filed'.
